params.name: Input
params.description: The page node (or page chain) whose image the shape is drawn onto. Without one the node produces nothing.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Outline to draw: a rectangle, an ellipse, a straight line, or a regular polygon fitted inside the Width by Height box.

params.name: X
params.description: Horizontal position of the shape's centre, in the page's Units from the page's left edge.

params.name: Y
params.description: Vertical position of the shape's centre, in the page's Units from the page's top edge (y runs down).

params.name: Width
params.description: Width of the shape's box before rotation, in the page's Units. For a line, its length.

params.name: Height
params.description: Height of the shape's box before rotation, in the page's Units. A line's thickness comes from Stroke Width instead.

params.name: Rotation
params.description: Turns the shape about its centre, in degrees; positive is clockwise as the page is viewed.

params.name: Corner Radius
params.description: Rounds the rectangle's corners, in the page's Units. 0 gives sharp corners; limited to half the shorter side.

params.name: Sides
params.description: Number of corners of the polygon, 3 to 64, with the first corner at the top. More sides approach an ellipse.

params.name: Fill
params.description: When on, the inside of the shape is filled with Fill Color. Turn off for an outline only.

params.name: Fill Color
params.description: Colour of the shape's fill; how solid it is comes from Fill Opacity.

params.name: Fill Opacity
params.description: Opacity of the fill, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid), blended over what is already on the page.

params.name: Stroke
params.description: When on, the outline is drawn in Stroke Color at Stroke Width. A line shape is drawn only while this is on.

params.name: Stroke Color
params.description: Colour of the outline, and of the whole line for the Line shape.

params.name: Stroke Opacity
params.description: Opacity of the outline, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid), blended over the fill and the page.

params.name: Stroke Width
params.description: Thickness of the outline in the page's Units, centred on the shape's edge (half inside, half out). For a line, its thickness.
